name: Spatial join benchmark data: GeoPandas and DuckDB Spatial
description: Reproducible experiment package for the manuscript "Effect of point data distribution on spatial join performance: A comparison of GeoPandas and DuckDB Spatial". Contains all source code, synthetic data generation scripts with fixed seeds (202601-202603), GeoParquet inputs, raw outputs of 240 main and 72 sensitivity timed runs, query plans, match-pair validation outputs, figure sources, the locked software environment and SHA256 checksums. Natural Earth inputs are public domain. See README.md inside the archive for usage.
